conviction_note: Findings sum to +1.1 (a habitual ~11% revenue beat that this name has sold twice, a put skew of +35 vol points and ~9 days to cover, a +13% sector-sympathy day into the print, and probably a first FY2027 guide whose sign is unknown). The scaled number is +0.36: abs_move 18% (event-implied 15.95%, the median absolute move on the four real prints is 25.6%, and a new-year guide is likely), times p_up 51. It is near zero because the print turns on the forward guide and on credit, and nothing found settles either one.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus revenue about $154.0M (about +32% y/y) and adjusted EPS $1.28 from 4 estimates (Earnings Whispers preview 2026-10-27, https://finviz.com/news/409647/sezzles-third-guidance-raise-faces-a-credit-and-marketing-test-in-the-third-quarter). Benzinga carries EPS $1.26 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SEZL/earnings-forecasts), so the EPS sources agree within $0.02. The revenue bar matches the company's own guide: FY2026 total revenue growth 35%, adjusted net income $185.0M, adjusted EPS $5.25, with H2 growth of 'around 30%' (Q2 release table https://www.stocktitan.net/news/SEZL/sezzle-reports-second-quarter-2026-d27npa8w3sq7.html and https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/sezl-stock-eyes-worst-day-in-a-year-on-mixed-analyst-actions-cautious-h2-guidance/cZofiXgRJ9u). Street FY2026 is $5.10 EPS and $592.6M revenue, below the company's $5.25 and about $607.9M, so the Street sits under the guide. The real bar is the Q4/FY2027 outlook and credit (provisions), not the Q3 revenue line. Real earnings prints rebuilt from EDGAR 8-K item 2.02s: 2025-11-05 -12.47%, 2026-02-25 +35.26%, 2026-05-06 +16.04%, 2026-08-06 -33.89%. The 2026-10-08, 2026-07-14, 2026-04-15 and 2026-02-02 item 2.02s are date announcements; 2026-10-08 is confirmed to contain no results or guidance (https://finviz.com/news/400584/sezzle-to-announce-third-quarter-2026-results-and-participate-in-upcoming-investor-conferences).
positioning_check: Short interest 4.43M shares, 9.2 days to cover, as of the 2026-10-15 settlement (https://massive.com/quote/sezl, read 2026-11-04). That is about 13% of the 33.76M shares outstanding. Youakim alone holds 39.6% (13D/A 2026-09-14), so the float is roughly 16-17M shares and short interest is about 25% of float (Chartmill puts float short at 25.75%: https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/SEZL/ownership). This is a crowded short. The 25-delta skew is +34.97 vol points (puts bid hard); put/call OI 1.09; event-implied move 15.95%; straddle 20.73% to 2026-11-20. Run-up: +21.8% over 20 days and +6.7% over 5 days, nearly all of it +13.4% today (122.43 to ~138.8) on a fintech sympathy rally: AFRM 71.97 to 76.96, UPST 21.37 to 23.75 after Upstart's Q3 print (Yahoo chart). That came after a -9% two-day slide on 1.5-1.7x average volume on Nov 2-3. Earnings Whispers bearish sentiment is 15.7%, down from 22.7% before the August print.

findings.finding: Sezzle has beaten revenue consensus by about 11-12% in each recent quarter: Q3 2025 $116.8M vs $104.7M (+11.5%), Q2 2026 $149.7M vs about $133-135M (+11-12%). Q3 2026 consensus of about $154M (+32% y/y) sits exactly on management's 'around 30%' H2 growth guide, so a beat of mid-single digits or more on the reported quarter is the base case. But the stock fell -12.5% (Nov 2025) and -33.9% (Aug 2026) on the last two beats of that kind.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats of about 11% came with -12.47% (2025-11-05, beat plus GMV slowdown and credit worries) and -33.89% (2026-08-06, beat plus a raise, sold on 'around 30%' H2 growth and yield normalising), and with +35.26% (2026-02-25) and +16.04% (2026-05-06) when the guide was raised sharply. The beat by itself has not set the sign.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. A habitual beater is expected to beat, and the Street's FY revenue of $592.6M is still below the company's own about $607.9M, which leaves a mechanical Q3/Q4 beat. If a full beat were priced, the Street would have moved its numbers to the company guide; it has not.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 beat size from https://business.mammothtimes.com/mammothtimes/article/stockstory-2025-11-6-sezl-q3-deep-dive-subscription-pivot-and-ai-drive-growth-amid-margin-compression; Q2 2026 beat from https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/sezzle-aktie-steigt-nach-upgrade-td-cowen-stuft-von-hold-auf-buy. Street-below-guide from the Earnings Whispers preview (finviz 409647). Different sources from the release.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management pre-warned three things for Q3: provisions could exceed 3% of GMV in Q3 (the FY framework is 2.5-3%; Q2 was 2.4%), revenue yield would decline sequentially as Pagaya and SezzleCash dilute the take rate, and marketing (Q2 $19.4M, 'not a run rate') would come down. A Q3 provision above 3% of GMV and a lower yield therefore land inside what the company guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Credit worries were cited in the -12.47% reaction of 2025-11-05; yield normalisation was the stated reason for the -33.89% reaction of 2026-08-06.
findings.why_not_priced: The pre-warning is public, so a provision above 3% of GMV that stays within guidance should be largely priced. The risk sits only in a provision well beyond the warning. If the market feared that, the put skew would be extreme, and it is (+35 vol points), so this is in the price.
findings.independence: Q2 provision of 2.4% of GMV and yield of 11.7% from the company release (stocktitan link in finding 1). H2 yield normalising to about 11.4% from https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/sezl-stock-eyes-worst-day-in-a-year-on-mixed-analyst-actions-cautious-h2-guidance/cZofiXgRJ9u.

findings.finding: A first FY2027 outlook is likely at this print: with the Q3 2025 print on 2025-11-05 Sezzle issued its first FY2026 adjusted EPS guide ($4.35), which it then raised to $4.70, $5.10 and $5.25. So this release probably carries a new-year guide, and the street has no company anchor for 2027. The sign is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has set the sign on every real print. First FY2026 guide on 2025-11-05: -12.47%. Raises in Feb and May 2026: +35.26% and +16.04%. Raise with an H2 deceleration in Aug 2026: -33.89%.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide's level is unknown to everyone. What is priced is its variance: a 15.95% event-implied move and a +35 put skew say the market fears a disappointment like August's. This finding raises abs_move_pct; it adds nothing to direction.
findings.independence: The guidance history table in the Q2 release lists 'Nov 2025: Adjusted EPS $4.35'. The same document as finding 1, a different line.

findings.finding: SEZL rose about +13.4% on 2026-11-04 (122.43 to ~138.8) into the print, on a fintech sympathy move with Upstart +11% and Affirm +7%. Upstart's Q3 print (2026-11-03) had originations +44% y/y, but CEO Paul Gu said 'macro is putting pressure on our near-term outlook', and its FY guide implies Q4 revenue of about $307M against Q3's $371M. The entry is at a higher price and a higher bar, on a peer whose own release flagged consumer-credit macro pressure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In the baseline, the August print came after a strong run (stock near $178) and fell -33.89%. The 2026-10-08 date-announcement day saw +9.74% with no news. The stock often runs into the print on sentiment.
findings.why_not_priced: The rally is the price; the question is whether it overshoots. A sympathy bid on a peer's volume beat, ignoring the peer's own macro warning, leaves SEZL's entry about 13% higher with nothing company-specific behind it. If the market had weighed Upstart's warning, SEZL would not have outrun Upstart on the day.
findings.independence: Price data from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SEZL?range=1mo&interval=1d and https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/UPST?range=10d&interval=1d. Proxy, not a Sezzle fact.

findings.finding: PayPal reported Pay Later growth of +25% in Q3 2026 against +26% TPV growth in Q2 2026. US BNPL demand held steady through the quarter Sezzle is reporting.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None for peer read-throughs on this name; Sezzle's GMV line has not set the reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a public peer series, largely priced, and only a proxy. A drop in PayPal's Pay Later growth would have been a visible negative for BNPL names; it did not come.
findings.independence: Proxy only. The metric (TPV or otherwise) is not confirmed in the source. Q2 2026 +26% per the same search; no independent confirmation.

findings.finding: Pagaya, which since May 2026 embeds its underwriting in Sezzle for longer-term point-of-sale loans, reported Q3 2026 network volume of about $3.6B (+29% y/y) on 2026-10-29, near the top of its $3.43-3.63B guide. Its referral channels, Sezzle among them, grew in the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. Sezzle management names Pagaya volume as a take-rate dilutor, so it adds GMV and lowers yield, which is a mixed line.
findings.why_not_priced: Sezzle's share of Pagaya volume is not disclosed, so the market cannot map it. This is weak evidence.
findings.independence: https://grafa.com/en/news/united-states/pagaya-q3-2026-revenue-rises-12-percent for the volume figure; partnership from https://stocks.observer-reporter.com/observerreporter/article/bizwire-2026-5-5-pagaya-announces-new-point-of-sale-partnership-with-sezzle-to-expand-consumers-options-for-sezzle-customers. Proxy.

findings.finding: FY2026 guidance excludes any material contribution from SezzleCash (live to all eligible Sezzle Anywhere subscribers by end of Q2; about 10% of eligible new subscribers used it as their first transaction) and Sezzle Send (August launch, 100k+ waitlist). On 2026-08-12 Sezzle amended its WebBank program so WebBank holds these new-product loans to maturity (retention threshold $30M, expandable to $150M; tangible net worth covenant raised from $12M to $100M). The financing buys a balance-sheet-light ramp of products the guide does not count, which gives the guide upside room.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises bought +35% and +16% in Feb and May 2026; a raise with deceleration sold -34% in August.
findings.why_not_priced: The amendment's terms sit in an 8-K that no preview cites; the Earnings Whispers preview mentions only that guidance 'assumes little' from SezzleCash. If the market expected an increase from new products, the Street's FY would sit at or above the company's $5.25, not at $5.10.
findings.independence: SezzleCash usage and the guidance exclusion from https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/sezzle-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-07/. A different document from the 8-K.

findings.finding: Crowded short into a print the options market has priced for downside: 4.43M shares short, 9.2 days to cover (2026-10-15), about 25% of float. A beat with a firm guide meets about nine days of covering demand; the put skew of +35 vol points means downside is already bought.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +35.26% move of 2026-02-25 came on a raise into a heavily shorted name; the -33.89% of August shows the short is not always squeezed.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew prices the downside; it does not price the covering flow on good news. If the market expected a squeeze, the skew would be flat or call-side, and short interest would have fallen into the print. It rose from about 4.0-4.35M in August to 4.43M.
findings.independence: August short interest of about 4.0-4.35M from https://altindex.com/ticker/sezl/short-interest and https://equibles.com/stocks/sezl/short-interest; float denominator from the 13D/A https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1662991/000166299126000155/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml.

findings.finding: Insiders kept selling. President and Director Paul Paradis sold about $16.3M (10b5-1) through July 2026, the CFO about $6.1M, and five insiders $25.4M over 12 months against $114k of buying. Two Form 144 notices were filed on 2026-10-09, a day after the Q3 date announcement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable; the sales are mostly scheduled 10b5-1 plans.
findings.why_not_priced: The sales are public and largely scheduled, so this is a weak signal. Who filed the October 144s was not established.
findings.independence: Totals from https://massive.com/quote/sezl (insider section). It shares a source with finding 8 for a different dataset.

baseline_tension: Mostly in line with the market: the options price a large two-sided move with strong downside demand (+35 skew), and this hunt finds nothing that settles the guide. The slight positive lean comes from a Street that sits below the company guide and a crowded short. That leans against the skew and comes after a +13% sympathy day, so p_up stays at 51.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sold its last two beats at -12.5% and -33.9%): finding 1 cut from +1.5 to +0.8.
Lesson 6 (a finding inside what the company already guided): the pre-warned Q3 provision above 3% and lower yield moved toward 0, from -0.5 to -0.2.

Lesson 7 (a sign against a strong +35 put skew): p_up cut from 52 to 51, so expected_move fell from 0.72 to 0.36. The crowded-short finding stays at +1.0, since the squeeze is a mechanism in its own right.

Lesson on an untrustworthy reaction history: the base rate was rebuilt from the four real prints (EDGAR), giving a median abs 25.6% that supports abs_move 18. This was already done before the file was read; no change.
Lesson 5 (proxies): the PayPal, Pagaya and Upstart findings were already small and labelled as proxies; left as they were.
